scanScope: Garnier 1877 from CHAPITRE II on p. 108 through the first half of p. 110 before CHAPITRE III; chapter title and all prose compared visually

canonicalDecisions.reason: Remove an apparent compositor hyphen between determiner and article; preserve all words. This correction was already present in the online transcription and is now documented.

sourceDecisions: The satirical dialogue and descriptions of different senses, planetary properties and lifetimes remain in their printed order.
The 'quinze mille ans' parenthetical and the selected Garnier readings remain part of the literary prose; nineteenth-century editor notes remain separate.
Record the p. 109 anomalous printed hyphen explicitly rather than treating the online transcription as exact facsimile.

unitReview.decision: 31 reviewed thought units reconstruct three chapter paragraphs. Nine passages contain 93–126 word tokens and stay within chapter boundaries.
manualBoundaries: Rejoin narrator attributions and split exclamations with their dialogue turns so no empty closing-quotation unit remains.
Separate the Saturnian's complaint about desire from Micromégas's reply after the original full stop.
Separate Micromégas's reply about the number of properties from the Saturnian's preceding explanation.
Attach the quote closing after 'pays-là.' and after 'ce monde.' to the corresponding spoken units.

lexicalNotes: Nature means the natural world in 'la nature est comme la nature' and 'ranimer la nature'; 'questions de cette nature' is the separately indexed kind sense.
The first batch's globe, Sirien and gravitation senses were checked in this chapter; remaining forms and expressions await review.
remaining: Review chapter II's remaining lexical occurrences, expressions and quiz coverage.
Continue scan and unit review with chapter III, starting at the CHAPITRE III heading on p. 110.
